question: What happens to the powers when awareness becomes contracted and seeks support?
premises: In contraction, awareness rests on support.
At that time its powers appear.
Those powers do not shine in the same way.
inference: Contraction alters the manifestation of powers so they no longer appear in their prior fullness.
uncertainties: The referent of support in ālambate is implicit.
plain_english: When contracted, it then takes support; its powers shine, but not in the same way as before.
